Data pre-pull

The Mini Program initiates a request in advance during cold startup and caches the request content. The cached data is used during the actual request, reducing the network request time.

Introduction

Generally speaking, the Mini Program obtains network data in the home page after loading using ma.request to achieve. At run time, the Mini Program developer can obtain data in advance of the next process that the user may trigger. The main function of Mini Program data prefetching is to initiate network requests and cache them according to the rules configured in the Mini Program before startup. After the Mini Program is started, the cached data is directly used to avoid loading or incomplete page display due to waiting for network data return.

Usage Process

Configuring a Prefetch Rule

Create preload.fetch in the root directory of the Mini Program project and fill in the preload configuration

preload.fetch Configuration

Note: The actual configuration file does not support comments. The comments in the following file are used to better describe the function of each field. Delete the comments from the configuration file when copying the file.

Attribute Type Mandatory or Not Description Default Value
fetchType String No Cache data type. The value is fixed to pre pre
params Object Yes Resolve the configuration request 
// preload.fetch
[
  {
    "fetchType": "pre", // Data pre-pull is fixed to pre
    "params": {
      "url": "https:*****", // Requested URL
      "method": "POST", // http method,Supports GET/POST
      "data": { "foo": "bar" },
      "timeout": 60000,
      "header": {
        // Optional. Additional header information Additional header information
        "content-type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
      }
    }
  }
]

（Currently, only the first 10 data records can be obtained in the preload.fetch file）

params configuration description

Attribute Type Mandatory or Not Description
url String Yes Developer server interface address，The variable ${token} is supported, Obtaining the token Through storage
header Object No Specifies the request header. Referer cannot be set in the header. The default value of content-type is application/json. Variables are supported.
timeout Number No Timeout interval, in milliseconds
method String No HTTP request method. The options are Get and Post.
data Object No Request parameter. Variables are supported

Obtaining Prefetched Data

ma.request Obtaining Prefetched Data

When the fetchType in the preload.fetch file is set to pre, ma.request is invoked to return the prefetched data.

The preload callback function is added to ma.request to return prefetched data

If the prefetch request is not complete when a normal request arrives, the preload returns the data prefetched last time

(The Mini Program is started for the first time. If the prefetch is not complete, the return value is null)

preload return value
Attribute Type Description
data String Data returned by the developer server
statusCode Number Prefetch Data Status Code
errMsg String Prefetch success or failure details

Sample Code

// Obtains prefetched data when fetchType in preload.fetch is set to pre
ma.request({
"method":"GET",
 "url":"https:*****",
 "header":{
   "content-type":"application/json"
 },
 "data":{
   "token":"xxxxxxx",
   },
 timeout:"60000"，
 success(res){},
 fail(res){},
 preload(res){ // Return prefetched data
    console.log(res.data)
 }
})

ma.getBackgroundFetchData Obtaining Prefetched Data

Call ma.getBackgroundFetchData to obtain all data in the data pre-pull cache

Bug & Tip

  • Each time the Mini Program is started, prefetching is performed again to update the cache
  • The cache is cleared each time the Mini Program is updated to prevent the cache from being too large
  • The maximum size of each cached data record is 1 MB
